items.title: Tuition fees
items.detail: From the university's official site, for the full course. Write each year separately.

items.title: Rent and bills
items.detail: Room, electricity, internet. Ask seniors about the real cost in that city.

items.title: Food and travel
items.detail: Groceries, bus pass, phone. Add the small costs too.

items.title: Emergency buffer
items.detail: Keep a part aside that is only for emergencies.

youtube.title: How to plan the cost of studying abroad? A simple budget sheet
youtube.description:
Your study abroad budget in 4 lines: tuition fees (from the official site), rent and bills, food and travel, and an emergency buffer. A written budget means fewer surprises.
